description: Lists result_entry rows awaiting authorization. Validate and Reject are already covered by existing contracts and are not duplicated here.

reused_apis.note: Already covers 'Validate result' - PATCH /api/result-entries/{resultEntryId}/authorize sets result_status = AUTHORIZED.

Already covers 'Reject result' - PATCH /api/result-entries/{resultEntryId}/status with body { resultStatus: 'REJECTED' }; use the existing result_entry.remarks column to record a rejection reason (no dedicated rejection_reason column on result_entry - see notes).

query_parameters.resultStatus: enum, optional, default COMPLETED - PENDING | IN_PROGRESS | COMPLETED | AUTHORIZED | REJECTED

validation: resultStatus, if provided, must be one of PENDING, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, AUTHORIZED, REJECTED (CHECK)
default filter (resultStatus=COMPLETED) represents results awaiting validation - completed but not yet authorized/rejected

errors.condition: resultStatus is not one of the allowed enum values
organizationId or branchId does not exist

constraints: result_status NOT NULL CHECK IN (PENDING, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, AUTHORIZED, REJECTED)

notes: result_authorization (database/schema/021_result_authorization.sql) has a dedicated rejection_reason column but, per API-097's notes, is not exercised by the current e2e authorization flow - result_entry.result_status is authoritative instead. Reject Result therefore reuses result_entry.remarks for the reason rather than inventing a new column; if rejection_reason tracking on result_authorization is required, that needs product/DB confirmation.
